about_the_game:
Test Instructions:

This test primarily focuses on evaluating and adjusting the stability of the AI service. The current AI is use Microsoft's AI service. Due to the high cost of real-time voice generation services, the voice quality demonstrated in the video cannot be utilized in this test. Moving forward, we will also integrate Byte Engine's large language models and voice services to achieve a relatively balanced state in terms of both performance and cost.

AIly's Daydream: AI Roomie is a gamified AI companion tool. The character in the game is driven by a large language model. You can customize her appearance, set her personality preferences, and define her way of speaking to match the way you want her to be. She has a real 3D avatar, her own independent 3D space, and even shares memories with you from your time together. She's no longer just a large language model that can only output text.

Customize the appearance and personality of your AI companion:

As you interact more deeply with your AI roommate, she will create memories that are unique to you and her. Of course, she is not just your companion but also a great assistant for your work and daily life. She can proactively change the music environment when you're feeling down. She can also help you record the happy or sad stories of the day. And of course, she can remind you of important things to help you live better in the real world.

Customize the room, day/night weather, and ambient sound effects:

Rich AI Commands:

You can trigger various AI commands in your conversations with your AI companion, allowing you to better utilize the game's features.

For example:

  • “If you're feeling down during a chat, your AI companion might suggest some cheerful songs and even change the tracks for you~”

  • “When you need to review some travel-related words you learned today, you can ask your AI companion to write these words into your notes. The next day, through memory, your companion can help you review these words!”

  • “When you're getting ready for bedtime reading, it can switch to a night-time environment for you.”

AI Command List:

  • Switch Day/Night

  • Change Weather

  • Enable Ambient Sound Effects

  • Music Control

  • Write Diary Entries

  • Create Tasks

  • Set Alarms

content_descriptors.notes: If players proactively guide the conversation with the AI, the AI Roomie may generate content that involves adult themes.

name: AIly's Daydream : AI Roomie Demo
short_description: AIly's Daydream: Gamified AI companion and focus tool with customizable AI roommate (appearance/voice/personality) for conversations and memories. The AI roommate actively adjusts the atmosphere, reminds you of tasks, accompanies you in focusing, and assists in planning.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
